description:
# Context

This fixture keeps a moderate narrative body while the local backlog discussion file carries most of the bulk. The prompt should summarize only the newest discussion entries and keep that summary bounded.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Discussion summary is newest-first
- [ ] Discussion summary is capped to three bullets or excerpts
- [ ] Discussion summary never exceeds the excerpt budget

## Validation

- `cargo test render_agent_prompt_discussion_summary_is_newest_first_and_bounded --lib -- --exact`
